adds.rationale: Fills the previously-unrepresented quantum wave with real commercial buildup: Q3 2023 revenue up 122% YoY and cumulative bookings crossing $100M a quarter ahead of guidance, right as the nuclear SMR thesis broke (see SMR remove).

news_evidence.summary: IonQ Q3 2023 revenue of $6.1M, up 122% YoY and above the high end of guidance
IonQ crossed $100M cumulative bookings a full quarter ahead of target, with $26.3M new Q3 bookings

removes.rationale: The flagship UAMPS/Idaho Carbon Free Power Project anchoring NuScale's SMR commercialization thesis was terminated in-quarter, triggering multiple sell-side downgrades — the fundamental thesis breach the guardrails call out for a remove.

news_evidence.summary: NuScale and UAMPS mutually agreed to terminate the 462MW Idaho SMR Carbon Free Power Project after insufficient subscriber uptake and costs rising to $9.3B
After the cancellation UBS cut its NuScale target $20->$13, TD Cowen downgraded to Hold, Citi reiterated Sell at $9

rationale_overall: A one-for-one wave swap, not a size change: SMR exits on a real dated thesis breach (flagship Idaho project cancelled, downgraded across the Street), and IONQ enters to give the quantum wave — named in the profile but previously absent — its first representation, backed by an in-quarter revenue/bookings inflection. The rest held: MSFT and GOOGL had concrete AI catalysts (OpenAI/Altman saga strengthening Microsoft's leverage; Gemini 1.0 Dec 6), NVDA showed no negative signal, RKLB's thesis was reinforced by a $515M SDA satellite award (Dec 21), and ITA continued to benefit from Israel/Ukraine defense demand. Result: MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA, ITA, RKLB, IONQ.
